// ─── Helper: format GAA score ──────────────────────────────────────────────
function fmt(goals, points) {
  return `${goals}-${String(points).padStart(2, '0')} (${goals * 3 + points})`;
}

// ─── Build output items (one item per match) ───────────────────────────────
return matches.map(match => {
  const h = match.homeTeam;
  const a = match.awayTeam;

  const homeScorers = h.players
    .filter(p => p.goals > 0 || p.points > 0)
    .map(p => ({ number: p.number, name: p.name, goals: p.goals, points: p.points, total: p.goals * 3 + p.points }));

  const awayScorers = a.players
    .filter(p => p.goals > 0 || p.points > 0)
    .map(p => ({ number: p.number, name: p.name, goals: p.goals, points: p.points, total: p.goals * 3 + p.points }));

  const homeCards = {
    yellow: h.players.reduce((n, p) => n + p.cards.filter(c => c === 'yellow').length, 0),
    black:  h.players.reduce((n, p) => n + p.cards.filter(c => c === 'black').length,  0),
    red:    h.players.reduce((n, p) => n + p.cards.filter(c => c === 'red').length,    0)
  };
  const awayCards = {
    yellow: a.players.reduce((n, p) => n + p.cards.filter(c => c === 'yellow').length, 0),
    black:  a.players.reduce((n, p) => n + p.cards.filter(c => c === 'black').length,  0),
    red:    a.players.reduce((n, p) => n + p.cards.filter(c => c === 'red').length,    0)
  };

  return {
    json: {
      matchId:   match.id,
      stage:     match.stage,
      venue:     match.venue,
      date:      match.date,
      status:    match.status,
      minute:    match.minute,
      score: {
        home: { team: h.name, formatted: fmt(h.goals, h.points), goals: h.goals, points: h.points, total: h.goals * 3 + h.points },
        away: { team: a.name, formatted: fmt(a.goals, a.points), goals: a.goals, points: a.points, total: a.goals * 3 + a.points }
      },
      scorers: {
        home: homeScorers,
        away: awayScorers
      },
      cards: {
        home: homeCards,
        away: awayCards
      },
      squads: {
        home: { name: h.name, players: h.players },
        away: { name: a.name, players: a.players }
      },
      events: match.events
    }
  };
});
